method.method_draft: Read the diagram as two slanted parallel lines a and b cut by the top horizontal line c. At the intersection of b with c, angle 4 is the upper-right angle; at the intersection of a with c, angle 2 is also the upper-right angle. Since a ∥ b and c is a transversal, corresponding angles give m∠2 = m∠4 = 57. Then at the intersection of a and c, angles 2 and 8 are vertical angles, so m∠8 = m∠2 = 57.
